name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate mechanics of his father's vintage motorcycle. He honed his skills through years of dedicated work in precision engineering, specializing in the fabrication and modification of engine components. His meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality have earned him a reputation as a reliable and innovative machinist.

In the high-pressure environment of motorsport, Thierry thrives on the challenge of pushing the boundaries of what's possible. He believes that even the smallest details can make a significant difference in performance, and he is always looking for ways to optimize designs and improve efficiency. Thierry's ability to remain calm and focused under pressure makes him an invaluable asset to any racing team, ensuring that every component is built to the highest standards.

What sets Thierry apart is his passion for problem-solving. He enjoys tackling complex challenges and finding creative solutions that others may have overlooked. His visionary approach, combined with his technical expertise, allows him to contribute to the development of cutting-edge technologies that can give a team a competitive edge.
